::: {.block title="Data"}
![Depth from ETOPO 2022; inset lines at 200, 1000 m. Argo floats / OOI sites: shelf 9 / 8, slope 41 / 4, open ocean 818 / 10.](figures/fig_data_map.png){#fig-data script="scripts/fig_data_map.py" width="100%"}

Measurements of chlorophyll(a) density from BGC-Argo and OOI chlorophyll profiles (March 2024 – October 2026) were averaged into 10 m bins to 200 m. Each data point (time, lat/lon, depth bin) was matched to PACE OCI L3 daily 4 km Rrs (172 bands) and OCLI L3 daily (11 bands). After dropping likely-biofouled profiles, this gave 9,542 Argo profiles (831 floats, global distribution) and 22,081 OOI 3 h windows (30 instruments, 6 locations).
:::
